name: Soulfull Millet muesli
ingredients: Rolled Oats (35%), Whole Wheat Flakes (20%), Millets (16%) [Ragi (9.7%), Jowar (6.3%)], Refined Sugar, Corn Flakes (5%), Invert Sugar Syrup, Almond (3%), Raisins (3%), Honey (1.3%), Malt Extract, Wheat Bran, Edible Vegetable Oil (Palmolein), Emulsifier (INS 322(i)), lodised Salt, Anticaking Agent (INS 170(i)), Natural Flavour, Antioxidant (INS 320). ALLERGENS: Contains Nut, Oats, Soy, Wheat.
